implementation: Added an optional JSON port contract passed by `m-model model probe --contract FILE` and selectable in the TTY Probe flow.

Validates nested input/output and per-module invocation ports, rank, dtype, PyTorch layout, memory format, fixed/symbolic dimensions and symbol ranges. Repeated/shared module calls retain invocation identity.

Runs best-effort torch.fx plus Meta inference. Confirmed static Linear inner-dimension failures report the FX module path and expected/actual values before real forward. Other trace/meta failures remain unsupported and proceed to real-batch probing.
Reports per-check coverage and leaves unexecuted module paths unobserved; a successful single sample does not claim all branches or shapes are correct.

verification.result: passed: 5 contract, 1 discovery, and 1 probe integration tests
passed: 53 modules, complete embedded asset coverage

limitations: Contract files are JSON in this release; semantic NCHW/NHWC axes are not inferred. `layout` means PyTorch Tensor layout and `memory_format` means contiguous/channels-last storage format.
FX/Meta is best effort. Only recognized static matrix/Linear dimension mismatch messages are classified as failed; other trace or Meta errors are unsupported and fall through to runtime probe.
Runtime contract evidence covers only supplied batches and observed invocations; it does not prove unexecuted branches or all shape ranges.
integration_patch: CLI request carries the optional contract path; worker reads it relative to project root, and worker_assets embeds contracts.py and shape.py. Cross-language report remains in existing JSON Report data; typed DTO normalization is future work.
